versions.changelog:
- Major update with bilingual documentation: entire SKILL.md now includes comprehensive English and Chinese sections.
- Added structured metadata fields: usage scenarios (read_when), platform and risk classification, interface and I/O schemas.
- Updated description fields to add bilingual summaries and clarify usage triggers.
- Expanded compliance and risk rationale notes; permissions and requirements now explicitly declared.
- General documentation and metadata improvements for clarity and interoperability.
- Added new resource files (AGENTS.md, llms.txt); removed skill-card.md.

- Initial release of data-grade-checker (版本 1.0.0).
- Provides automated data classification and grading based on GB/T 43697-2024 regulations.
- Outputs JSON IR for integration; includes error codes and risk tip handling.
- Zero-dependency, CLI-based tool with built-in examples and clear usage instructions.
- Designed for decision support—results require manual verification and are not legally binding.
